Fairway Island


Fairway Island, added to Oaklands in the 1.84.0 update alongside golf-themed items, is a special location connecting to the Grasslands Beach in Finlay. The island offers a golfing shop, which offers golf clubs, special turf materials, and other golf-related items. The island offers 18 holes in total. These 18 holes are based off of locations in other parts of Oaklands, including Ferwater, the Desert Highlands, Mushroom/Uncertainty Cave, Boomite Caves, the Finlay Taiga, the Snowy Peaks, the Icelands, the Acidlands, the River Caves, and Magma Caves.

Note that all the stone/ore nodes and trees that are here serve as obstacles only. You can not use any axe or pickaxe on any of the resources that spawn here.

Stores

Hole in One

The Hole in One is the only shop on Fairway Island. The store is run by Mr. Golf. The store offers a wide variety of Golf-related items, specifically the golf clubs needed to complete the Golden Golf Club quest. Furthermore, he offers Seasonal Grass that changes with the biome you spawn in and dyeable golfing Turf. The store also offers special Tube schematics.

  • Unlike cars, Golf Clubs and Drivers all have equal probabilities of color.
  • Golf Clubs have a 1/100,000 or 0.001% chance to be a Neon variant (even rarer than Neon variant cars at 1/10000!).
    • Normal Golf Clubs sell for $1000. To have an estimated 100% chance of obtaining one, it would roughly cost $10 million for a Neon Golf Club, depending on RNG.
    • Normal Drivers sell for $3000. To have an estimated 100% chance of obtaining one, it would roughly cost $30 million for a Neon Driver, depending on RNG.

Quests and Secrets

The Golden Golf Club

When talking with the NPC, Mr. Golf, in the shop, he reveals that he will provide a special reward to those who complete all 18 holes on Fairway Island. However, you do not need to talk to Mr. Golf to initiate the quest. After completing all 18 holes, talk with Mr. Golf to claim your reward. He will provide you with the Golden Golf Club, the Golden Driver Golf Club, and the Golden Golf Tee.

  • This quest can take some time depending on how skilled you are at ROBLOX golf to complete.

Secret Bonus Holes

There are several secret holes on Fairway Island, but they do not give any rewards. Even so, these holes are typically much harder compared to the standard set of 18 holes for the Golden Golf Club quest. For example, one of these holes is located on a rock island.

Instead of following the normal path from the entrance, drive to the right - you should see a small brown rock island off a bit into the distance. There is, in fact, a golf flagpole on this small island. The golf tee for this secret 19th hole is on a stump; follow the signs in the small forest to reach it. A Driver Golf Club appears to be required to score on this hole.

Secret route 20 - from the magma caves to the IceLands peaks. In one of the corners of the magma cave, find a golf ball and bring it to the top of the left IceLands mountain.

Secret route 21 - from the peak of AcidLands to the oasis. Find a ball on one of the peaks in AcidLands and then bring it to the farthest edge of the oasis, to the hole below the waterfall.

Please note that there are no rewards for secret holes. Take your time at your own risk.

  • If you are thinking of cheating by using blocks or crates to make these secret holes easier, think again! Golf balls on Fairway Island go through these items.
  • You can only get to the secret hole 19 with one shot, as the distance from the shore to the hole is too long.
